description: Use this when the user asks whether tickets are getting cheaper or pricier, what it costs to get in, which events dropped or rose in price this week, or how an event's price has moved. Returns TicketSea's daily ticket price figures from TickPick's lowest listed all-in prices: the median get-in price (overall or for one category such as nfl or concerts) against a week earlier, the week's biggest drops and rises and the priciest events, each with its TicketSea page. With slug, one event's lowest price by day since TicketSea began tracking it. Mostly US events; one marketplace, one listing per day, not live inventory. Credit the figures as "TicketSea analysis of TickPick listings" with a link to the page.

category.description: Only this category's figures: nfl, nba, nhl, mlb, wnba, concerts, theatre, family or sports. Omit for every event.

slug.description: An event slug from a search result, for that event's lowest price by day.

name: get_ticket_prices
